message: シャッターチャンス

name: Ria
message: 「Synn-kun.」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, yes.」

name: Ria
message: 「You should really take a break soon.」

name: Synn
message: 「But... while everyone else is working, for just me to...」

name: Misa
message: 「What are you talking about? It's the opposite, the opposite.」

name: Synn
message: 「The opposite?」

name: Misa
message: 「Right now, the rest of us all have our hands tied with work we can't step away from, while you're the only one with free time, aren't you?」

name: Synn
message: 「It's not like I have free time...」

name: Misa
message: 「You have free time.」

name: Synn
message: 「Mgh.」
Well, my hands are a little free, sure, but...

name: Misa
message: 「Besides, even if just you were gone, it wouldn't really make much of a difference anyway.」

name: Synn
message: 「Mmph.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Misa is overly aggressive, isn't she? Like that, even things that would settle down won't.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Can't help it since she's hysterical.」

name: Misa
message: 「What did you say?!」

name: Ria
message: 「Synn-kun. The people with free hands have to take their breaks first, you know.」

name: Synn
message: 「But what if something happens...」

name: Ria
message: 「Hey now. Rely on us a little bit!」

name: Synn
message: 「...I see. So that's how it is.」

name: Misa
message: 「Impressive as always, Onee-sama. She convinced Sakura-kun effortlessly...」

name: Misa
message: 「Still, what is this faint sense of dissatisfaction?」

name: Synn
message: 「Wait, why are you glaring at me?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Even though the content hasn't changed, it doesn't rub anyone the wrong way. Is this what they mean by wisdom comes with age?」

name: Ria
message: 「It's not that different.\s02」

name: Nanaka
message: 「So hurry up and go get some rest!」
Whoa! The whole place is packed and booming!
Seeing everyone having so much fun makes me happy too.

name: Paqy
message: 「So, Synn-sama.」

name: Synn
message: 「What?」

name: Paqy
message: 「You finally get a chance to slack off, so why are you wandering around aimlessly?」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm not slacking off.」

name: Paqy
message: 「I get that you don't wanna admit it.」

name: Synn
message: 「I told you, that's not it.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Don't tell me you're looking for that mysterious transfer student?」
Before I knew it, I had been looking for Azel.

name: Paqy
message: 「You'd better steer clear of that girl. Take it from the great sage himself, you can't go wrong.」

name: Synn
message: 「It's nothing like that.」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm just a little worried about her.」
Worrying about a transfer student who isn't used to her new environment is only natural for a Student Council President working hard for everyone's tomorrow and happiness.

name: Paqy
message: 「Hehehe... Classic Synn-sama. To deceive your enemies, first deceive your allies. Fooling even yourself to catch her off guard and make her yours--」

name: Paqy
message: 「Shapan!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah.」
Spotted Azel sitting on a bench.

name: Synn
message: 「Mind if I... sit next to you?」
I checked first, figuring she'd run off if I just sat down out of nowhere.
No answer, so I'll take that as a yes.

name: Synn
message: 「Are you okay? You look pretty exhausted.」

name: Azel
message: 「I am not tired.」

name: Synn
message: 「You don't look like it, though.」

name: Azel
message: 「...I'm not.」
Is she tired?

name: Synn
message: 「You took a whole bunch of pictures and got worn out.」

name: Synn
message: 「Well then, how about we--」
I started to suggest we get something to drink together, then realized I didn't have any money.

name: Synn
message: 「If we go back to headquarters, they'll at least serve us some tea.」

name: Synn
message: 「Would you rather have coffee instead of tea?」

name: Azel
message: 「No.」

name: Synn
message: 「Then... milk or something?」

name: Azel
message: 「...I can't.」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Azel
message: 「I can't take pictures.」

name: Synn
message: 「What do you mean, you can't... why?」

name: Synn
message: 「It's a digital camera, so you don't have to worry about running out of film, you know?」

name: Azel
message: 「...There are too many.」

name: Synn
message: 「Things you want to take pictures of?」
After hesitating for a moment, Azel gave a small nod.

name: Synn
message: 「Like I said, you can take pictures of whatever you want, and since it's a digital camera, there's no need to worry about how much space is left.」

name: Synn
message: 「If you don't know how to use the computer, I can--」

name: Azel
message: 「No.」

name: Azel
message: 「That's... not it.」

name: Synn
message: 「Then why?」

name: Synn
message: 「Was it a bother?」

name: Azel
message: 「...It's a nuisance.」

name: Synn
message: 「I see... I guess I practically forced you into doing it, huh.」

name: Azel
message: 「That's right.」

name: Azel
message: 「N-no... That's not it.」

name: Synn
message: 「Not it?」

name: Azel
message: 「Well... It's not... your fault.」

name: Synn
message: 「But I forced you.」

name: Azel
message: 「Yeah, it is your fault... Still, no... Not being able to take the shot isn't on you.」
The exact moment I was about to ask what she meant by that.
The flapping of several birds erupted from behind us.
I sensed Azel gasp and turn around.
When I turned around too, a flock of pigeons that had been gathered on the lawn was taking off all at once.
Azel pointed her camera at them, looking as if she were about to take the picture at any second.
Yet her finger stayed frozen just like that, and the pigeons flew away.
Azel lowered her eyes sorrowfully.
At least, she looked sorrowful to me.
Could it be because she missed her photo opportunity?

name: Synn
message: 「So close.」

name: Synn
message: 「Still, you'll have plenty more chances.」

name: Azel
message: 「Nothing will... remain anyway.」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Azel
message: 「...Never mind.」

name: Synn
message: 「I don't think it's true that nothing will remain, though.」

name: Azel
message: 「I said never mi--」
Starting to stand up without looking at me, Azel spun around as if startled.

name: Azel
message: 「Who's there?」

name: Synn
message: 「Your little brother, Azel?」

name: Azel
message: 「I don't have one.」
A boy around five or six years old was clutching the hem of Azel's skirt.

name: Synn
message: 「At least, that's what this big sister says, but is it true?」
The boy gave a small shake of his head.

name: Azel
message: 「I told you he isn't mine.」

name: Synn
message: 「Could it be... did you get separated from your mama?」
The boy gave a small nod.

name: Synn
message: 「Whereabouts did you get separated?」

name: Lost Boy
message: 「...Over there.」
The boy pointed vaguely off to the right.

name: Synn
message: 「...Over there?」

name: Lost Boy
message: 「Yeah. Over there.」
I double-checked, though it wasn't much of a clue at all.

name: Synn
message: 「...Um, what's your name?」

name: Itsuki
message: 「Itsuki Satou.」

name: Synn
message: 「So your name is Itsuki.」
Itsuki gave a small nod.

name: Synn
message: 「Itsuki, don't worry--we'll find your mom for you.」

name: Azel
message: 「There is no 'we.'」

name: Synn
message: 「Eh, really?」

name: Azel
message: 「Do it yourself.」
Cutting me down in a single stroke, Azel said,

name: Azel
message: 「Let go.」
Itsuki gripped Azel's skirt even tighter.

name: Azel
message: 「Let go.」
Itsuki's pleading gaze refused to leave Azel.

name: Azel
message: 「Do whatever you want.」

name: Synn
message: 「Looks like he's taken a liking to you.」

name: Synn
message: 「Let's look for her together, okay?」

name: Azel
message: 「...Can't be helped.」
For the time being, we headed in the direction Itsuki-kun pointed.

name: Sacchin
message: 「Ah, slacking off~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「No, we're just taking a break.」

name: Synn
message: 「What about you, Nanaka?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Obviously she came to gorge on sweets~」

name: Synn
message: 「I see.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Wrong! I came to supervise the afternoon delivery!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Anyway, Azel-chan. Since I recommended you for caramel duty, if you don't take it seriously, it'll fall on me~」

name: Azel
message: 「You didn't.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I told you it's not caramel. Besides, you wouldn't take responsibility anyway.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「If the caramel person doesn't keep making caramel, the sugar will burn and it'll be a disaster~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Listen to what people say for once!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Aaah! You even have a secret love child now~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「A secret child!? N-No way!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Look, the facial features are a dead ringer for the two of them~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「N-Now that you mention it...」

name: Synn
message: 「We don't look alike.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「You should've hidden away one or two yourself, Nana-chan~」

name: Synn
message: 「It's a lost child.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I know that... Synn doesn't have the backbone for that anyway.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「No good, Nana-chan. All guys make excuses like that. Even without a backbone, they can still knock someone up~」

name: Azel
message: 「...A lost child.」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm thinking of trying to look for their parents.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey. Where did you get separated from your mom?」

name: Itsuki
message: 「...Here.」
Nanaka looked all around, and I followed suit, scanning the area.
People, people, people, people.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Go have them make an announcement at the main office.」

name: Synn
message: 「...Would that be faster?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Sacchin. Give that thing from earlier to this kid.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「I already ate it all up~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Then what's with that hand behind your back?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「You're imagining things~ I'm not hiding anything~」
Azel casually snatched the soft-serve ice cream Sacchin had hidden behind her back.

name: Azel
message: 「...Here.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Aah! My soft-serve--thief!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You weren't hiding anything, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「I see, which means it doesn't belong to Sacchin either.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Eh, ah, ugh~」

name: Azel
message: 「Eat up.」

name: Itsuki
message: 「Thank you, big sis!」
Azel turned her head away.

name: Sacchin
message: 「Even though I was the one who gave it to him~」

name: Synn & Nanaka
message: 「You didn't!」

name: Synn
message: 「Misa, Shio-chan. Good work on patrol.」

name: Misa
message: 「Sakura-kun. D-Don't tell me, that child is...」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, this kid is.」

name: Misa
message: 「K-Kidnapper!」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Shio
message: 「Is that true!? How shameless!」

name: Synn
message: 「It's a lost child.」

name: Misa
message: 「Criminals always make excuses like that.」

name: Shio
message: 「Synn-dono! If you are a man, you ought to honorably admit your wrongdoing and commit seppuku. I shall gladly act as your second!」
First an illegitimate child, and now kidnapping.
Guys... just what kind of person do you think I am...
Azel stepped forward as if to shield Itsuki.

name: Azel
message: 「...This kid's lost.」

name: Misa
message: 「...Oh. Right. That makes much more sense.」

name: Shio
message: 「Oh, how careless of me! Please forgive my grave rudeness!」

name: Synn
message: 「...I'm just glad this ridiculous misunderstanding is cleared up.」

name: Shio
message: 「Misunderstanding or not, slandering Synn-dono is an unforgivable offense. I am prepared to accept whatever punishment you deem fit.」

name: Misa
message: 「You didn't do anything wrong, Shio. It's Sakura-kun's own fault for how he usually behaves.」
I really wanted to object to that part about how I usually behave, though.

name: Synn
message: 「...I don't mind, really.」

name: Shio
message: 「How magnanimous! Truly the demeanor of one meant to stand above others. You have my utmost respect!」

name: Misa
message: 「Still, you didn't think this through.」

name: Synn
message: 「What do you mean?」

name: Misa
message: 「Instead of searching around yourself, having headquarters make an announcement would be much faster. You really don't use your head.」

name: Synn
message: 「...I'm on my way there right now.」

name: Misa
message: 「I-I knew that much!」
The rich, roasted aroma of green tea drifted through the air.

name: Ria
message: 「Oh, Synn-kun. You could've rested a little longer, you know.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Pardon me for intrudin'.」

name: Synn
message: 「No, thank you very much for bringing refreshments.」

name: Ria
message: 「I'll pour some tea right now. Azel-san, is your data full already?」

name: Synn
message: 「That's not what's going on.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「I see, a Student Council President kidnapping someone--how bold.」

name: Ria
message: 「Akane-chan, there are some things you shouldn't say even as a joke. There's no way Synn-kun would ever do something like that.」
*Sniffle*......
Ria-senpai is the only one who believes in my character......

name: Misasagi
message: 「Ooh, scary. Don't get so mad. Of course a boy Rii-a dotes on wouldn't do anything that naughty.」

name: Ria
message: 「Of course he wouldn't. Here you go.」
Ria-senpai pours tea for me, Azel, and Itsuki-kun.

name: Misasagi
message: 「Can you handle hot drinks, little guy?」

name: Itsuki
message: 「I'm fine.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「What an adorable child. Looks just like the President when he was little.」

name: Ria
message: 「Really? Wait, how do you know what Synn-kun looked like when he was little, Akane-chan?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「......Ah, I really do have a big mouth. Forgive me, President.」

name: Synn
message: 「Um, I have no idea what you're talking about.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Rii-a. Forgive me for keeping it a secret. This boy is actually the love child between me and the President.」

name: Ria
message: 「A-A love child!? W-Wha--No way!」

name: Synn
message: 「Don't 'I see' this!」

name: Azel
message: 「It makes logical sense.」

name: Synn
message: 「No it doesn't!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Now that the cat's out of the bag, you can call me 'Mama' like usual. If you do, I'll give you a kashiwa mochi.」

name: Itsuki
message: 「......Miss, you're not my mama.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「This kid isn't cut out to be a merchant.」

name: Azel
message: 「So it's not true.」

name: Ria
message: 「Of course it's not! There's no way Synn-kun would ever do anything lewd enough to make a baby! You're always teasing people, Akane-chan!」

name: Synn
message: 「You just tried to subtly bribe me, didn't you!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Rii-a. Does the president prefer gentlemen instead?」

name: Ria
message: 「Th-That's not what I mean! S-Synn is a boy, yes, but, um, we don't do that kind of thing!」

name: Ria
message: 「A-Anyway, we need to make the announcement for him right away!」

name: Ria
message: 「Masami Satou. Masami Satou. Your child, Itsuki Satou, is waiting at the KiraFes headquarters in the Central Plaza.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Where is the lost child, where is he!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ooh. So this child is a lost child! I've never seen a lost child before! Hohoh~. Hmmm.」
Itsuki hid behind Azel.

name: Azel
message: 「Don't scare him.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I am not scaring him at all! I was merely exercising a bit of curiosity. Isn't that right, Jiiya?」

name: Riesling
message: 「When it comes to finding the parents of a lost child, please leave it to me, Riesling Tooyama.」

name: Synn
message: 「In a crowd this huge, that's impossible.」

name: Synn
message: 「Wait, he's already gone!?」

name: Ria
message: 「Like a ninja.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Because he is Jiiya.」

name: Synn
message: 「Even though he doesn't even know their names or faces......」

name: Riesling
message: 「I have secured the parents.」

name: Synn
message: 「So fast.」

name: Riesling
message: 「Now then, right this way please.」
At Riesling's prompting, the parents appeared.
Both of them looked on the verge of tears.

name: Itsuki
message: 「Mama! Papa!」
Itsuki ran up to his parents and threw his whole body into hugging them.

name: Itsuki
message: 「Waaaaaaaaaaaaah.」
Perhaps because the tension finally broke, Itsuki sobbed loudly. Tears glistened in his parents' eyes as well.

name: Ria
message: 「I'm glad.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「What a heartwarming scene~」
Riesling nodded silently.
Azel aimed her digital camera at the three of them. In the end, it looked like she couldn't bring herself to take the shot.
As his parents bowed and thanked us over and over again, Itsuki finally calmed down.
He started to leave holding hands with his parents, but suddenly let go and came running back over to us.

name: Itsuki
message: 「Big sis, big bro, thank you!」
It was a dazzling smile.
Azel sprang up from her chair as if jolted, and aimed her digital camera.
She pressed the shutter button.
Itsuki flashed a big grin and threw a V-sign at Azel and me.

name: Itsuki
message: 「Camera big sis. Big bro. Thank you so much!」
With that, Itsuki ran off back to his parents.

name: Azel
message: 「...Thank you.」
I think I was the only one who heard that quiet murmur.
There wasn't much time left until KiraFes came to an end.

name: Synn
message: 「You sure took a lot.」
As I clicked the mouse.
The scenes packed tightly into Azel's digital camera were transferred to the laptop I'd brought to headquarters.
I began opening the thumbnails lined up in the storage folder.
The lively sights of KiraFes.
Students frying up yakisoba.
Heated haggling. An old man huffing and puffing from buying too much.
The new school building, the old school building, the church.
The busy-looking people of the shopping district.
A middle-aged man throwing a V-sign when the camera was pointed at him.
A woman laughing heartily while holding a giant daikon radish in one hand.
A red balloon. A child chasing after the balloon.
Parents and children spreading out a bento lunch on the lawn.
Finis Tower soaring, bathed in the setting sun.

name: Synn
message: 「Did you have fun?」

name: Azel
message: 「...I didn't have fun.」

name: Synn
message: 「I see.」
Looks like she enjoyed herself.
Truth is, I didn't even need to ask--I could tell just from the scenes Azel had captured.
Besides, if she hadn't been having fun, there's no way she would have kept coming back to headquarters over and over just to save her data.

name: Synn
message: 「Maybe you didn't have fun, then. Still, I think every single one of these is a really great photo.」

name: Azel
message: 「...I see.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. If there's another event sometime, I'm counting on you.」

name: Azel
message: 「...No way.」

name: Synn
message: 「I see.」

name: Azel
message: 「I said no.」

name: Synn
message: 「I know, I know.」
She doesn't actually hate it.

name: Azel
message: 「...Do you really?」

name: Synn
message: 「I said I do.」

name: Synn
message: 「I went ahead and saved them all nice and proper.」
I handed the digital camera to Azel.
If I asked if she still wanted to take more, she'd probably just say no.
From the headquarters booth, Azel gazed out over the KiraFes venue for a while.

name: Synn
message: 「What's up?」

name: Azel
message: 「None from here.」
Saying that, she raised the digital camera and started taking pictures.
She meant she hadn't taken any shots from this angle yet.
Across the venue, now beginning to flush with the colors of dusk, cleanup was getting underway here and there.
Like a spell slowly unraveling, it was a slightly lonely sight.

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, Azel.」

name: Synn
message: 「After you took that girl's picture... how come you were able to start taking photos again?」
Azel didn't answer me.
Even so, the sound of her clicking the shutter was pleasant.
Engrossed in her camera, she looked so full of life.
I felt like I didn't even need an answer.
Besides, Azel would only say it was on a whim anyway.
Suddenly, words slipped from Azel's lips.

name: Azel
message: 「In that moment.」

name: Azel
message: 「There was something wonderful there.」

name: Azel
message: 「I couldn't help but take the shot.」

name: Azel
message: 「That's all.」
She doesn't say it's pointless. Azel.
The fact that she didn't call it pointless made me kinda happy.
Azel's hands stopped.

name: Azel
message: 「Hey, you.」

name: Synn
message: 「Eh, ah, it's not like I was staring at you or anything, Azel.」

name: Azel
message: 「No.」

name: Synn
message: 「...What?」

name: Azel
message: 「What's your name?」

name: Synn
message: 「...Mine?」
Azel turned her face away, looking slightly down,

name: Azel
message: 「Just figure it out.」

name: Synn
message: 「I introduced myself before, so I thought you already knew.」

name: Azel
message: 「Wasn't listening.」
Having to say it all over again makes me a little embarrassed.

name: Synn
message: 「It's Synn Sakura.」

name: Azel
message: 「...I see.」
Azel fiddled with the digital camera for a while, then suddenly aimed it at me.

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Synn
message: 「Why?」
Azel muttered while playing with the digital camera in her hands.

name: Azel
message: 「Had space left over.」

name: Synn
message: 「I figured as much.」

name: Azel
message: 「It's just because I had space left over.」

name: Synn
message: 「I know, I know.」

name: Azel
message: 「That's all.」

name: Synn
message: 「I get it already.」

name: Azel
message: 「That's the only reason, got it?」
Azel hurried out of the headquarters.
I created a separate new folder and put only the data with me in it inside.
As for why I ended up making it a hidden file... I don't think there's any meaning to it.
